question: If lr0 had been scaled to the validation farm's rotor diameter fraction (50 m = 50/240 D_train; ROWP D=198 -> lr0 = 50*198/240 = 41.25 m), would the deployment choice change? Train evaluation (DEI, lr0=50) unchanged by design.
deployment_rule_confirmed: Log + README confirm the historical rule: max backfilled ROWP AEP among train-feasible AND rowp-feasible. It selects iter_192 (rowp 4271.49) exactly. The best-train-AEP rule would instead have selected iter_179 and does NOT reproduce the deployed choice.

new_deployment_rule_B_actual.family: cosine LR (no bumps) + 5x lr-coupled alpha + quadratic late ramp + 70% alpha dip at t=0.7, beta1=0.3 beta2=0.5 — same alpha-dip explore/enforce lineage as iter_192 but without iter_192's dual Gaussian LR bumps

new_deployment_rule_A_stated.rule: best log train AEP among train-feasible AND rowp-feasible@41.25
new_deployment_rule_A_stated.note: iter_179 is rowp-feasible at both 50 and 41.25, so under this rule nothing changes; but this rule does not reproduce the historical iter_192 deployment.

train_lr50_reproduction.note: [reeval, log]. 5/9 exact, 1 within 0.5 noise floor. iter_177/179/192/228 differ 4-6 GWh from ORIGINAL-run values but exactly reproduce the log's own later current-stack re-scores (e.g. iter_179->5560.90 = late attempt 323; iter_192->5561.58 = late attempt 335): historical cross-stack drift (pre-vendored pixwake), not a tool error.

rowp_lr50_reproduction.note: all exact vs backfilled (current-stack) log values

mapping: iter_NNN.py == attempt NNN for NNN<=236 (identity; also the convention the repo's own cleanse_and_backfill.py used). Established by ordering the 316 original-window train entries (timestamp<1775.5e6, train_aep in (5000,5700)) against the 316 iter files sorted by number; file numbering has gaps at 237-255 and 288-290. Verified empirically by exact AEP reproduction (train: iter_099/123/165/166; ROWP: iter_166/179/181/192).
log_anomaly: attempt_log.json has 423 attempts vs 316 files. (1) Attempts 321-423 (timestamps 11 days after the run) are post-run generalization/N-sweep matrix evals: train_aep 2318-8830 spans the problem_dei_n30..n100 farms (values >6570 exceed the N=50 farm's capacity); train_baseline stays 5540.72 because run_optimizer always attaches the farm-1 baseline. Marked rowp_backfilled/families. Excluded. (2) Four original-window entries (attempts 307/309/311/313, aep 4240-4600) are ROWP-scored entries interleaved in the train log; excluded. (3) rowp_aep fields were backfilled post-hoc on the current stack; train_aep fields are original-run values, which for a minority of LR-bump-sensitive schedules differ 4-6 GWh from current-stack re-evaluation.
